scope: Independent Node CLI commands with original synthetic fixtures. No live Gateway, network provider, model billing, private data or remote publication.

observations.reason: Loadable CLI scaffold returned SESSION_CLI_NOT_IMPLEMENTED; no missing-module or import failure.

verifiedBoundaries: Default start produces a real saved report; independent inspect returns persisted original question, binding and root usage.
Completed resume keeps the exact Run, directory, receipt, report mtime and cumulative root usage.
Each of five supported fixtures starts in an independent CLI process; inspect and resume retain that exact case and fixture binding version.
Cancel updates only durable cancellation state and zero tool/model usage in its control-only fixture; repeated cancel is monotonic.
Live, unknown fixture or unsupported gateway version is refused before any substitute Gateway executes.
Resume --case mismatch refuses instead of changing the stored Run identity.
Unknown, duplicate, missing and action-incompatible arguments fail before creating a database.
Inspect, cancel and resume require an existing session.sqlite and do not initialize missing directories.
boundariesNotClaimed: These CLI tests restore settled results, not forced termination at every Runtime boundary; actual interruption/resume evidence is separately owned by the Runtime suite.
SIGINT/SIGTERM forwarding is implemented but no dedicated CLI signal-race qualification is claimed by this suite.
No Web Chat, background Worker, public network server, sandbox, model semantics or external exactly-once guarantee.
